source.title: Combining experiments and mechanistic modeling to compare ventilated packaging types for strawberries from farm to retailer

interpretation: Literature-calibrated respiration-driven remaining fruit quality model. It is not trained from the ColdTrace six-shipment dataset and is not a food-safety model.
absolute_rql_requirement: Absolute remaining quality life requires an externally supplied starting remaining quality life or starting quality state. Without it, only observed-exposure impact is reported.
